title: Concentric cylinders: profiles against the exact solution
status: final (rc2 runs) for g <= 200 dx; the rows at g = 400 dx are not reached
caption: Circular Couette flow of the micropolar fluid between concentric cylinders (R1 = 4 g, R2 = 5 g, rotor at Omega, w = 0 on both walls): bin means of the azimuthal velocity (a, b) and of the micro-rotation (c, d) over the last quarter of the run (bins of one dx, about forty shown; every bin in the insets, which cover the 0.08 g next to the rotor and to the stator) against the exact solution (line). (a, c) K = 3, l = 25 dx, m = 2, g = 100 dx, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf (25 on mu), run `g100_k3_m2`; (b, d) K = 3, l = 10 dx, m = 10, g = 200 dx, Ma = 0.02, Re = 10 on mu_inf (25 on mu), run `g200_k3_m10`. Tag `thesis-ch5-rc2-1-gcb243fd`, `thesis-ch5-rc2-2-g7a21ef4`. Rms deviation from the exact profile, relative to the rms of the profile: m = 2: v 9.5e-05 in the core and 8.2e-04 within h of a wall, w 2.9e-03 and 5.0e-03; m = 10: v 1.2e-04 in the core and 4.3e-04 within h of a wall, w 1.9e-03 and 6.7e-03.
